message.content: {"component_id": "BAY-02", "confidence": "high", "contradictory_evidence_ids": ["EV-IMG-SRV001_BAY02_GREEN", "EV-IMG-SRV001_BAY02_GREEN-VISION"], "decision_summary": ["Verified device SRV-001 BAY-02 identity and green LED observation", "Inspected SMART telemetry showing warning with 34 pending sectors and 0 reallocations", "Corroborated pending sectors via kernel scrub warning log", "Consulted vendor manuals for LED meaning and pending-sector interpretation", "Determined green LED alone insufficient and discriminating surface scan not yet run"], "device_id": "SRV-001", "incident_id": "INC-SRV-001-BAY-02", "missing_information": "Extended diagnostic surface scan (surface_sector_verification) not yet executed to determine if 34 pending sectors clear to zero with zero reallocations per MAN-TELEMETRY-01; no post-scan SMART Attribute 05/197 verification.", "reasoning": "Green LED on BAY-02 suggests normal operation per MAN-LED-01, but SMART telemetry EV-TEL-SRV001-BAY02-S1 reports smart_status=warning with current_pending_sectors=34, reallocated_sectors=0, predictive_failure CLEARED, RAID optimal. Event EV-LOG-SRV001-0001 corroborates 34 pending sectors during background scrubbing. Per MAN-TELEMETRY-01, pending elevated with reallocated zero may be transient soft errors rather than physical defect and requires extended surface scan to discriminate; if scan clears pending to zero with zero reallocations drive is cleared, replacement only if reallocations increase or errors persist. Therefore drive cannot be declared 100% healthy (not_confirmed prohibited with abnormal pending sectors) and cannot be declared confirmed failure without the discriminating test. Status is more_evidence_required.", "recommended_action": "Do not replace drive at this time. Schedule and run extended surface scan on SRV-001 BAY-02 per MAN-DIAG-01 (30-120 min disruptive), then re-check SMART 05/197; if pending clears to 0 with zero reallocations clear drive for service, if reallocations increase or unrecoverable errors persist initiate replacement; continue monitoring for EVT-NVME-MEDIA-WARN.", "status": "more_evidence_required", "summary": "SRV-001 BAY-02 shows green LED but is not verified 100% healthy: SMART warning with 34 pending sectors requires extended surface scan to distinguish transient errors from media defect.", "supporting_evidence_ids": ["EV-TEL-SRV001-BAY02-S1", "EV-LOG-SRV001-0001", "MAN-TELEMETRY-01", "MAN-LED-01", "MAN-DIAG-01"]}
